summary: Ecopetrol S.A., the Colombian state-controlled integrated oil company listed on the BVC and NYSE (ADR: EC), filed a Form 6-K reporting resolutions adopted at an Extraordinary General Shareholders' Meeting held September 15, 2026 in Bogotá. Shareholders approved an amendment to Article 20 of the bylaws governing the composition, renewal, and election of the Board of Directors, proposed by the Nation of Colombia through the Ministry of Finance and Public Credit, plus instructions to align the Board Succession Policy and internal governance instruments with the amendment, suspending any minimum-incumbent-member requirement as a condition precedent to full board election. No price, stake, or transaction terms were disclosed; the event is an internal governance/board-succession restructuring rather than a merger or tender. Watch for subsequent board composition announcements and any shift in state influence over strategy or capital allocation.
